PUBLIC TABLEAU WORKBOOK SOURCES

1. Tableau Exchange Accelerators (recommended first complete-workbook source)
   https://exchange.tableau.com/accelerators
   Official download instructions:
   https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/accelerators.htm

   Tableau documents Accelerators as prebuilt dashboards with sample data.
   Sign in to Tableau Exchange, choose an Accelerator, and select Download
   to obtain a TWBX packaged workbook. An account is required by the documented
   workflow. Choose a simple sales dashboard before complex industry examples.
   Prefer an example whose sample data can be exported or accessed separately:
   bundled Hyper data is not read by this repository's analyzer.

2. Tableau Public
   https://public.tableau.com/
   https://help.tableau.com/current/pro/desktop/en-us/publish_workbooks_tableaupublic.htm

   Search for Superstore or a simple dashboard. Use the visualization's Download
   menu and choose Tableau Workbook when available. Download availability depends
   on the author's settings; do not bypass disabled downloads. Public visibility
   alone does not grant redistribution rights.

3. Tableau sample datasets and official tutorial
   https://public.tableau.com/app/learn/sample-data
   https://help.tableau.com/current/guides/get-started-tutorial/en-us/get-started-tutorial-home.htm

   These are useful for creating controlled Tableau workbooks with known totals.
   A downloadable Excel/CSV dataset is NOT a TWB/TWBX report test case by itself.
   Save a workbook from Tableau after building the desired chart/calculation.

LOCAL CORPUS PRACTICE

Keep authorized downloads under ignored workbooks/ or downloads/. Do not commit
third-party workbooks, data, images, or extracts. Follow source terms and record
provenance privately: source URL, author/publisher, retrieval date, download
permission, file hash, Tableau version and relevant license/use restrictions.
Do not upload source workbooks to external conversion services.

Suggested progression:
  A. Self-authored synthetic fixture: parser contracts only (already included).
  B. Simple downloaded workbook: fields, basic charts, filters, one dashboard.
  C. Controlled Superstore workbook: known grouped totals and calculation results.
  D. Advanced workbook: LOD, table calculations, actions, parameters, multiple
     sources, device layouts; expect explicit review and unsupported decisions.

Record parser outcomes separately from Desktop refresh and numerical/visual
parity. A publicly downloadable workbook can still lack accessible upstream
data, require connector credentials, exceed conservative archive limits, or
contain unsupported features. Never relax those limits silently.

No third-party workbook has been downloaded or included in this repository.
